short_description: APASS survey filters, defined as Johnson B, V and SDSS i, z

licence.terms: "You should also acknowledge APASS with the following credit line"
licence.scope: AAVSO APASS page (step 1: the page SVO cites, https://www.aavso.org/apass), read from the Internet Archive capture of 20 Jan 2024 because the live aavso.org returns 403 to curl on 2026-10-26. The page asks for a credit line but states no licence terms; it covers the APASS survey, not explicitly the filter curves. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: This research was made possible through the use of the AAVSO Photometric All-Sky Survey (APASS), funded by the Robert Martin Ayers Sciences Fund and NSF AST-1412587.

notes: DetectorType of sdss_g, sdss_i, sdss_r, sdss_z set to photon, DetectorTypeSource original (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: The curve is the SDSS 2001 public response table (https://classic.sdss.org/dr7/instruments/imager/, column 2: point source through 1.3 airmasses). Doi et al. (2010, AJ 139, 1628) obtain the response functions as quantum efficiency (§II), weight them 'to give the photon number' (§III, eq. 3) and integrate magnitudes as ∫d(log ν) f(ν)R(ν) (§IV, eq. 4), applied to this public table: photon counting. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
